intro.h2: Cabinets, counters and crews under one roof
paragraphs: Modern Kitchen has offered kitchen remodeling in Elkhart since 1946, from a showroom at 30513 Old US 20 West. What began as cabinets built by hand in a garage is now a full design, selection and installation team for kitchens and baths across Northern Indiana and Southwest Michigan.

Projects start at the showroom. A designer looks at how you cook, store and gather, then draws a plan around those needs and your budget. Cabinetry, Cambria countertops and appliances are picked in one visit, and Modern Kitchen's own staff carries the job from planning to completion, whether it is new cabinets or a full renovation.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Elkhart and the services around it

items.name: Kitchen Design
items.blurb: Every project starts as an empty canvas. Modern Kitchen's design professionals work out function and storage, colors and style, and the difference between necessities and wish lists, then build a plan around those needs and your budget. Large projects or small, complete renovations or new cabinets.

image.alt: Loft-style kitchen design with a dark island, warm under-counter lighting, open pipe shelving and tall windows

items.name: Cabinetry
items.blurb: Aristokraft for affordable kitchens and baths, semi-custom Diamond, and premium KitchenCraft. Choose contemporary or French Country, dark woods or light, natural wood finish or painted. The team helps you match door style, finish and features to the way you live and the look you like.

image.alt: Goshen area kitchen with navy lower cabinets, white upper cabinets, butcher block counters and a marble-look waterfall island

items.name: Countertops and Appliances
items.blurb: Cambria countertops, with a Roomvo visualizer on the site to preview styles in your own room, plus natural stone and laminate options. Modern Kitchen has also sold appliances for over 60 years, including Amana, KitchenAid, Maytag and Whirlpool, matched to your layout and budget.

image.alt: Kitchen with charcoal cabinets, a waterfall quartz island with seating, professional range and black pendant lights

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Bathroom cabinetry, countertops and fixtures, designed and installed by the same team that does the kitchens. Past clients have asked for everything from a claw foot tub to a master bath redo after their kitchen was finished, and many come back for the guest bath next.

image.alt: Elkhart bathroom remodel with a floating black double vanity, white vessel sinks, black framed mirrors and marble-look tile

why_choose_us.h2: Why Elkhart families keep coming back

items.title: Three generations, one philosophy
items.text: Mark's grandfather Lance started out building cabinets by hand. Mark's father Steve joined in 1964 and Mark in 1986. Grandpa's rule, be honest and give exceptional service, still runs the business.

items.title: Recognized at 75 years
items.text: State Representatives Doug Miller and Dale Devon presented Mark Jones with greetings and congratulations from Governor Eric Holcomb when Modern Kitchen marked its 75th anniversary.

items.title: Real people you can name
items.text: Google reviewers thank designers Tammy and David by name. Tammy Case, Dave Flock and Michael Lang handle sales and design, and Willis Roberts is the finish carpenter.

items.title: Repeat clients
items.text: One Granger interior designer says Modern Kitchen has remodeled her last three kitchens. A South Bend couple had their kitchen done, then their master bath, with the guest bath next.

about.h2: Mark Jones and a cabinet shop that started in a garage
about.text: Modern Kitchen began with Mark Jones's grandfather, Lance, building cabinets by hand in his garage, and the business has served the area since 1946. Mark's father, Steve, joined him in 1964, and Mark followed in 1986. A lot has changed since then, from cabinet brands to appliances, but the family says one thing has not: Lance's belief in being honest and giving exceptional customer service. Today Mark is president, and the showroom team serves homeowners, builders and remodelers. In Mark's own words, the goal is to help you redesign, remodel and relax.

image.alt: Mark Jones, president of Modern Kitchen in Elkhart, Indiana

service_area.h2: Serving Northern Indiana and Southwest Michigan
service_area.text: The showroom is on Old US 20 West in Elkhart, and the team works across Northern Indiana in South Bend, Granger, Mishawaka, Elkhart and Goshen, plus Southwest Michigan. Past clients quoted on the site live in South Bend, Granger, Elkhart and Cassopolis, Michigan. If you are close to the state line, call and ask whether your address is in range.

faq.h2: Questions Elkhart homeowners ask Modern Kitchen

items.q: Which cabinet brands do you carry?
items.a: Modern Kitchen sells Aristokraft cabinetry for affordable kitchens and baths, semi-custom cabinetry by Diamond, and premium KitchenCraft cabinets. Styles run from contemporary to French Country, in dark or light woods, natural wood finishes or paint. A designer helps you narrow the choices to the right door, finish and features.

items.q: Can I see a countertop in my own kitchen before I buy?
items.a: Yes. Modern Kitchen offers Cambria countertops, and its products page includes the Roomvo room visualizer, which lets you try different countertop styles in a photo of your own room or in sample rooms. The showroom also has natural stone and laminate countertop samples to compare in person.

items.q: Do you remodel bathrooms as well as kitchens?
items.a: Yes. The same design and installation team handles bathroom cabinetry, countertops and fixtures. One Elkhart client got the claw foot tub she always wanted, and a South Bend couple had Modern Kitchen remodel their master bath after their kitchen, with the guest bath next on their list.

Yes. Modern Kitchen has been in the appliance business for over 60 years and carries brands including Amana, KitchenAid, Maytag and Whirlpool. Because appliances are the first step in a kitchen design, the team matches them to your layout, needs and budget, and also sells laundry pairs like washers and dryers.

The showroom at 30513 Old US 20 West in Elkhart is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM. The contact page also lists Saturday hours of 9 AM to noon, and evening appointments are available. Call (574) 674-9989 to confirm a time with a designer before you drive over.

final_cta.h2: Bring your kitchen ideas to the showroom
final_cta.text: Call Mark and the design team at (574) 674-9989 to set up a visit, or send a message and they will reach out to plan your kitchen or bath.
